sourceTexts.hebrew: וְהָאָדָם יָדַע אֶת־חַוָּה אִשְׁתּוֹ וַתַּהַר וַתֵּלֶד אֶת־קַיִן
sourceTexts.aramaic: ואדם ידע ית חוה אנתתיה והרת וילדת ית קין
sourceTexts.greek: Αδαμ δε εγνω Ευαν την γυναικα αυτου και συλλαβουσα ετεκεν τον Καιν
sourceTexts.latin: Adam vero cognovit uxorem suam Hevam quae concepit et peperit Cain
sourceTexts.geez: አዳም ሔዋንን አወቀ እርስዋም ፀነሰች ቃየንን ወለደች
sourceTexts.syriac: ܘܐܕܡ ܝܕܥ ܠܚܘܐ ܐܢܬܬܗ ܘܒܛܢܬ ܘܝܠܕܬ ܠܩܝܢ
sourceTexts.coptic: Adam de afsooun n-Eua tefshime; acermisi ebol acmsi n-Kain
sourceTexts.armenian: Ադամը ճանաչեց Եվային իր կնոջը, նա հղիացավ և ծնեց Կայենին

hebrewWitnesses.label: Codex Leningradensis (B19A)
hebrewWitnesses.text: וְהָאָדָם יָדַע אֶת־חַוָּה אִשְׁתּוֹ וַתַּהַר וַתֵּלֶד אֶת־קַיִן
hebrewWitnesses.transliteration: Vehaadam yada et-havah ishto vatahar vateled et-qayin
hebrewWitnesses.literalPt: O homem conheceu Eva, sua mulher, e ela gerou Caim.

hebrewWitnesses.label: Aleppo Codex
hebrewWitnesses.text: וְהָאָדָם יָדַע אֶת־חַוָּה אִשְׁתּוֹ וַתַּהַר וַתֵּלֶד אֶת־קַיִן
hebrewWitnesses.transliteration: Vehaadam yada et-havah ishto vatahar vateled et-qayin
hebrewWitnesses.literalPt: O homem conheceu Eva, sua mulher, e ela gerou Caim.

hebrewWitnesses.label: Dead Sea Scrolls (Qumran)
hebrewWitnesses.text: וְהָאָדָם יָדַע אֶת־חַוָּה אִשְׁתּוֹ וַתַּהַר וַתֵּלֶד אֶת־קַיִן
hebrewWitnesses.transliteration: Vehaadam yada et-havah ishto vatahar vateled et-qayin
hebrewWitnesses.literalPt: O homem conheceu Eva, sua mulher, e ela gerou Caim.

greekWitnesses.label: Septuaginta (LXX)
greekWitnesses.text: Ἀδὰμ δὲ ἔγνω Εὕαν τὴν γυναῖκα αὐτοῦ, καὶ συλλαβοῦσα ἔτεκεν τὸν Κάϊν
greekWitnesses.transliteration: Adam de egno Heuan ten gynaika autou kai syllabousa eteken ton Kain
greekWitnesses.literalPt: Adão conheceu Eva e ela, concebendo, deu à luz Caim.

greekWitnesses.label: Tradição Bizantina Grega
greekWitnesses.text: Ἀδὰμ δὲ ἔγνω Εὕαν τὴν γυναῖκα αὐτοῦ, καὶ συλλαβοῦσα ἔτεκεν τὸν Κάϊν
greekWitnesses.transliteration: Adam de egno Heuan ten gynaika autou kai syllabousa eteken ton Kain
greekWitnesses.literalPt: Adão conheceu Eva e ela, concebendo, deu à luz Caim.

greekWitnesses.label: Recensão Luciânica (Antioquena)
greekWitnesses.text: Ἀδὰμ δὲ ἔγνω Εὕαν τὴν γυναῖκα αὐτοῦ, καὶ ἐν γαστρὶ λαβοῦσα ἔτεκεν τὸν Κάϊν
greekWitnesses.transliteration: Adam de egno Heuan ten gynaika autou kai en gastri labousa eteken ton Kain
greekWitnesses.literalPt: Adão conheceu Eva, sua mulher; e ela, tendo concebido, deu à luz Caim.

ptLiteralVerse: E o homem conheceu Eva, sua mulher; ela concebeu e deu à luz Caim.
enLiteralVerse: And the man knew Eve his wife; she conceived and bore Cain.
